Info

Domain service coordinating waypoint additions, removals, updates, and resets.

class scarajectory.core.service.trajectory.plan.mutation.plan_mutation_service.PlanMutationService(store: IWaypointStore, history: IPlanHistorySaver, selection: IPlanSelectionManager, dispatcher: IPlanObserverDispatcher)[source]¶

Domain service coordinating waypoint additions, removals, updates, and resets.

methods:
